svg.title: DEMO — interdigitated top contacts and a true geometric cutaway
svg.desc: Original illustrative 3D model with two connected but mutually separated comb electrodes. No physical scale, data or paper reproduction.

g.text: DEMO · original teaching geometry · not to scale · no measured dimensions
Gold identifies both metal networks; teal identifies the semiconductor. Color does not encode a measured field.
No contact chemistry, field solution, photocurrent or fabricated dimensions are asserted. Layer thicknesses are exaggerated.
